source_of_truth: The degraded-honesty + structured cross-surface-AGREEMENT half of the Experience Readiness typing layer, CARVED OUT of 2a-core (2026-06-15-001) by operator split decision after F004 produced high findings in consecutive rounds (per-family honesty, F002/F004 shared exclusion, objective-level comparison keying). This plan CONSUMES 2a-core's shared EvidenceRef fields (data_source, availability, consumer_family, degraded_mode) and the closed surface_class/evidence_class enums; it MUST NOT lock until 2a-core is merged. It owns: per-family degradation honesty, allowed_degraded_modes consumption, the typed-skip-vs-real discriminator at the evidence-set level, and OBJECTIVE-LEVEL cross-surface availability/provenance agreement keyed by (objective, data_source).

user_journeys.name: degraded-honesty-and-structured-agreement
user_journeys.description: When a required data source is unavailable, both families degrade honestly (human label; agent structured capability_unavailable), a typed-skip proves honest unavailability rather than success, and human and agent journeys for the same objective agree on availability/provenance compared by a shared data_source key.
acceptance_signals: a required data_source with no EvidenceRef carrying availability=unavailable for that key (from either family) -> degraded_dishonest; the checker reads structured EvidenceRef fields {data_source, availability, data_provenance}, never prose
a journey 'covered' only by typed-skips is NOT satisfied (typed-skip = honest unavailability, not success)
human vs agent journeys asserting different availability/provenance for the SAME data_source key -> cross_surface_disagreement (compared on structured fields, not prose)
an honestly-degraded journey (label or structured signal present) passes
cross_surface_disagreement is computed at the OBJECTIVE level: EvidenceRefs grouped by objective key then by data_source; the comparison boundary is the (objective, data_source) pair (D006)

required_evidence: checker tests: per-family degraded_dishonest, allowed_degraded_modes consumption, typed-skip-not-success discriminator, and OBJECTIVE-level keyed cross_surface_disagreement (F001)
non_goals: the TYPING/SCHEMA/HARNESS layer (surface_class/evidence_class/consumer/EvidenceRef fields, typing rule, agent harness) — sibling plan 2a-core (2026-06-15-001); this plan CONSUMES it
the QuantRE Product Readiness plan; rebuilding human-surface capture; accessibility/visual depth
completion_test: One feature passes: a pure checker over 2a-core's structured EvidenceRef fields reports per-family degraded_dishonest (each required consumer_family must carry its own honest availability=unavailable signal), validates degraded_mode against the journey's allowed_degraded_modes, treats typed-skip as honest-unavailability never success (evidence-set discriminator), and detects cross_surface_disagreement at the OBJECTIVE level keyed by (objective, data_source). Consumes 2a-core vocabulary; does not redefine it.
